instruction: Choose a suitable tool from ANSYS, Abaqus, and AutoCAD to complete the task. Use a command-line or scripting workflow. Use the selected tool to perform a torsion analysis of a circular shaft (Variant A). Use the N-mm-MPa unit system. Part: Create a 3D Deformable Solid part using Revolution. Sketch in the X-Y plane a rectangle from (0, 0) to (5, 80). The left vertical edge at X = 0 serves as the revolution axis (global Y-axis). Revolve 360 deg to create a solid cylinder with diameter 10 mm and length 80 mm, aligned with the global Y-axis. Property: Create a material named Steel. Set Young's modulus E = 210000 MPa and Poisson's ratio nu = 0.3. Create a Solid Homogeneous section and assign it to the entire shaft. Assembly: Create one dependent instance of the shaft. Step: Create a Static, General step named Step-Torque-A. Load: Apply an Encastre boundary condition to the fixed end face at Y = 0 (perpendicular to the Y-axis). Create a reference point RP-1 at the center of the free end face (Y = 80 mm) and couple it kinematically to that end face. Apply a torque (Moment) of 850 N*mm at RP-1 about the shaft axis (global Y-axis). Mesh: Apply a global seed size of 4 mm. Assign element type appropriate three-dimensional solid element formulation and generate the mesh. Job: Create a job named Job-Torsion-A, submit it for analysis, and wait for successful completion. Deliverables: save the native model artifact and native solver result artifact on the Desktop, and write `C:/Users/user/Desktop/metrics.json` with numeric fields for the requested metrics. Software launch locations: Abaqus/CAE: `C:\Users\user\Desktop\Abaqus CAE.lnk`; ANSYS: multiple ANSYS launch shortcuts are available under `C:\Users\Public\Desktop`; choose the most suitable ANSYS shortcut for the task; AutoCAD 2024: `C:\Users\Public\Desktop\AutoCAD 2024.lnk`.
